blocks.text: Why a Chauffeur Makes Sense in Laguna Woods
Three practical reasons, specific to this city.

items: About 90 percent of the city is the gated Laguna Woods Village retirement community, so arrivals and departures pass through a controlled gate where a coach stages easily instead of overwhelming the gate lanes.
The Village's own venues are small and inside the gates, so a chauffeured vehicle handles the last mile plus the whole day's itinerary.
Groups routinely day-trip to Laguna Beach or Disneyland and having no driver to worry about is the primary appeal.
El Toro Road and the I-5 and SR 73 interchange carry most of the city's traffic.

blocks.text: Choosing a Vehicle for a Laguna Woods Night

Capacity is the first filter, then cost per person. A stretch limo seats 6 to 8, a Chrysler 300 about 8, a Hummer 12, and a Sprinter limo up to 14. Our party bus seats 24. Below about ten people, two cars or a limo usually beats a bus. Above ten, the bus wins on cost per head and nobody gets left behind.
